messages:
jamie-peopleops: Heads up — getting multiple calendar invites + duplicate scorecards for the same candidates this morning. Started ~08:15am. Looks like the ATS webhook is firing twice for the same event.

Drew-recruiter: Yep, several candidates pinged me. Their calendars show two invites 1 minute apart. Scorecards show two entries too. Which webhook endpoint is that hitting?

luis-data: I can grab the webhook payloads from our receiver logs. Sample payload we got: 
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_abc123",
  "candidate_id": "C-9876",
  "action": "INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED",
  "sent_at": "2026-03-23T08:14:32Z",
  "details": { "slot": "2026-03-30T15:00:00Z" }
}
```

jamie-peopleops: Thanks — noticing payloads from ATS don't include a request_id, only event_id. ATS has a retry policy and seems to re-send the same event_id, but our webhook handler isn't deduping by event_id.

dave-eng: Which service runs the webhook consumer? schedule-worker? I can grep logs and add a quick dedupe by event_id if that's the problem.

infra-bot: deploy-bot queued a patch: add-eventid-dedupe to schedule-worker (PR #3421). :rocket:

sarah-talent: Can we get a temporary workaround? Interviewers are confused which invite to accept. We need to pause the retries on the ATS side while you patch.

Drew-recruiter: I reached out to ATS support and asked them to pause retries. They want evidence of duplicates (payloads + timestamps). I shared the two payloads for a candidate.

luis-data: I ran a quick query and found ~18 candidates affected (duplicates within 60s). I can run a one-off dedupe script to merge duplicate scorecards and cancel duplicate invites. Will need write perms to calendar service.

anne-hiringmgr: Can interviewers safely ignore the second invite? Some already accepted both and are double-booked.

jamie-peopleops: Short guidance for interviewers: accept the earliest invite and delete the duplicate, if both are same time keep earliest one in your calendar. We'll update the interviewer playbook after fix. Posting a short checklist now: 
- Do not fill duplicate scorecards; wait for People Ops to merge.
- If double-booked, pick one and notify candidate + hiring manager.

dave-eng: I pushed a small change to schedule-worker to store processed event_ids for 5 minutes (simple in-memory cache + fallback to DB for longer window). PR merged, rolling restart scheduled.

infra-bot: schedule-worker rollout started (canary 1/3) — monitor: logs/schedule-worker/canary.

luis-data: Running dedupe job now (TICKET-4682). Script: `python scripts/dedupe_scorecards.py --by event_id --dry-run` — will run live at 10:00 PST after confirmation.

jamie-peopleops: Action items: 
- @dave-eng: confirm rollout completed and share deploy window.
- @luis-data: run live dedupe at 10:00 PST and post results.
- @drew-recruiter: keep ATS paused on retries until we confirm.
- People Ops: update interview playbook to include steps for duplicate invites/scorecards.

anne-hiringmgr: Thanks — please tag me when dedupe finishes, I need to follow up with impacted candidates.

jamie-peopleops: Will do. Posting logs gist for ATS support: https://redwood.internal/gists/gh-2123456789 (internal). Anyone seeing more live reports, DM me. :eyes:

drew-recruiter: ATS has paused retries. They asked for the fix timeline — told them ~30m.

jamie-peopleops: Confirmed dedupe ran at 10:07 PST, 18 duplicate scorecards merged, 34 duplicate invites cancelled. Closing TICKET-4682 after monitoring for 1hr. If someone sees a duplicate after 11:15 PST, please ping me directly.

sarah-talent: Great work, team. I'll update the training doc with the quick triage steps and a screenshot example.

jamie-peopleops: Closing note: we'll add event_id idempotency docs to the integration guide and add a note to interviewer training: "If you see duplicate calendar invites, accept earliest and don't submit duplicate scorecards — People Ops will merge." Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
